how.title: How does mixing work?
how.description: The service accepts coins, splits them into many parts, sends them through different routes, and returns them to new addresses without linking to the original transactions.

steps.title: Receiving funds
steps.description: You send BTC to our deposit address. Only 1 block is needed to start.

steps.title: Pool gathering
steps.description: Deposits from several clients are combined to break obvious links.

steps.title: Splitting
steps.description: The amount is divided into dozens of fragments with different fees and time delays.

steps.title: Different routes
steps.description: Parts go through separate chains and land in new blocks without repeating patterns.

steps.title: Payout
steps.description: Clean coins go to the addresses you provide. You can split across several wallets.

steps.title: Support
steps.description: Keep the session ID. It’s used to check status and get help.

items.question: What is WashBit?
items.answer: A service for anonymous bitcoin exchange and cleaning. We remove risky tags and never require AML/KYC so your funds stay safe to use.

items.question: How many confirmations do you need?
items.answer: Only 1 confirmation in the network, then splitting and mixing begin.

items.question: Do you keep logs?
items.answer: No. We don’t store IPs, address databases, or KYC. Data is wiped after the session is finished.

items.question: How to contact support?
items.answer: Write directly on Telegram: @washbitBot. Keep the session ID so we can help quickly.

items.question: What is the fee?
items.answer: From 3 to 7% depending on delay and dispersion + 0.0007 BTC network fee.

items.question: What amounts do you handle?
items.answer: Minimum 0.005 BTC. Maximum 50 BTC per session — larger can be split or agreed with support.
